summary: Frontend-only verification for Invisacook profile customization (iteration 15): (1) sidebar logo swaps to Invisacook when logged in as invisacook role, and (2) brand-filter popover on Ordens de Serviço is hidden for invisacook. ServiceOrdersPage.js is ~3000 lines — highly recommend splitting into feature-specific subcomponents (filters, list, modals).
